description: Mediciones de exposición a campos electromagnéticos is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Agencia Nacional del Espectro - ANE, Bogotá D.C.. Contiene la información recopilada por la Agencia Nacional del Espectro a través del Sistema de Monitoreo de Campos -SMC-, para vigilar los límites de exposición de las personas a los campos electromagnéticos, adoptados mediante la Resolución 773 de 2023. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Agencia Nacional del Espectro - ANE, Bogotá D.C.. Its tags are ane, rni, estación radioeléctrica, radiación, espectro. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación. The portal shows 2024-08-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
